verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a project-management SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Trello's own source being published or licensed openly. The Power-Up skeleton and sample code are developer building blocks for extensions, not the product's source, and the open-source WeKan mentioned by a user is a different product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
